function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician and former army officer who served in the state government of Telangana. He was elected as a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Jangaon constituency in 2014 and held cabinet portfolios, most notably as Minister for Transport and later as Minister for Rural Development. Reddy was a prominent member of the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) party. His tenure was marked by several controversies, including allegations of land‑deal irregularities and corruption. In 2019 he was arrested on charges related to these allegations, though he was later released. Reddy’s career reflects the broader trend of former military officers entering Indian state politics, bringing their leadership experience but also facing scrutiny over governance and accountability.
